name: Light theme is the default on first load
description: The site loads in light theme by default (dark available via the persisted toggle).

planSteps.description: Navigate to / with no stored theme preference (fresh/clear localStorage) and a neutral prefers-color-scheme
Verify the first paint is the LIGHT theme — page background is light/near-white and text is dark. The default must be light (not dark); a dark first-load fails.
